reason: M01 blocked: no official dated ward-level inundation records or audited negatives exist (S43, T085), so labels, features and flood probabilities cannot be built (T089).

S43.retry_condition: Re-run T085 when one of these holds: (1) GBA, BBMP, KSNDMC or KSDMA publish dated ward-level flood incident records, for example control-room logs released on OpenCity; (2) the BBMP and GBA websites pass TLS verification, so their releases can be checked; or (3) at T222 the owner decides to accept the I Change My City complaints as non-official, citizen-reported labels with a written coverage rule for negatives, recorded in the decisions log. Without one of these, the C2 fallback applies.
